SPIREDUO-PICNIC_FOR_TWO.title: Picnic for Two
SPIREDUO-PICNIC_FOR_TWO.pages.INITIAL.de:
A sunny clearing, a checkered blanket and a basket packed far too full.

Someone planned this. There are bamboo shoots, eucalyptus sandwiches and exactly enough for two... [sine]if nobody gets greedy.[/sine]
SPIREDUO-PICNIC_FOR_TWO.pages.SHARE.desc:
You split every bite down the middle. The food runs out fast, but nobody minds.

You both feel [green]refreshed[/green].
SPIREDUO-PICNIC_FOR_TWO.pages.FEAST.desc:
Nobody holds back. Within minutes the basket is empty and everyone is lying on the blanket.

[sine]You feel very full.[/sine]
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.title: Stargazing
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.pages.INITIAL.descri:
Far from the noise of the Spire, you find a quiet hill under a sky full of stars.

You lie down side by side. For a while, nobody says anything.

Then a [gold]shooting star[/gold] streaks across the sky.
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.pages.MAKE_A_PROMISE:
You hook your little fingers together and make a promise under the stars.

Whatever waits up there, you'll face it [gold]together[/gold].
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.pages.WISH.descripti:
You sprint down the hill toward where the star fell, trip over a root and tumble the rest of the way.

At the bottom, something is [gold]glowing[/gold] in the grass.
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.loss: {character} chased a falling star at [gold]{event}[/gold] and never came back.
SPIREDUO-LITTLE_QUARREL.title: Little Quarrel
SPIREDUO-LITTLE_QUARREL.pages.INITIAL.de:
It started with something small. Who ate the last bamboo shoot? Whose turn was it to keep watch?

Now you're sitting back to back, arms crossed, and neither of you wants to speak first.
SPIREDUO-LITTLE_QUARREL.pages.INITIAL.op: Add [gold]Make Up[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
Lose [red]{Damage}[/red] HP. Remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
"...Sorry."

A long pause. Then a small voice behind you: "Me too."

The air feels [green]lighter[/green] already.
You stomp off into the woods and kick a tree. It hurts. A lot.

By the time you come back, your head is [gold]clear[/gold] and you've forgotten what the fight was about.
SPIREDUO-LITTLE_QUARREL.loss: {character} stormed off at [gold]{event}[/gold] and never came back.
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.title: Photo Booth
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.pages.INITIAL.descr:
Wedged between two crumbling pillars is a [gold]photo booth[/gold], its curtain half open and its lights still blinking.

Nobody knows who put it here. It still takes coins.
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.pages.INITIAL.optio: Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Duplicate a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.pages.PHOTO.descrip:
Flash! The booth whirs and prints two copies of the photo.

One for each of you.
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.pages.SILLY_FACES.d:
You pull the silliest faces you can manage. The booth flashes, sputters and refuses to print.

Still, laughing that hard makes you feel [gold]stronger[/gold].
SPIREDUO-THE_LAST_DUMPLING.title: The Last Dumpling
SPIREDUO-THE_LAST_DUMPLING.pages.INITIAL: Only one dumpling remains. Both pairs of eyes follow it around the plate.
Gain [green]{MaxHp}[/green] Max HP. Add a [gold]Wound[/gold] to your Deck.
SPIREDUO-THE_LAST_DUMPLING.pages.SPLIT.d: The halves are uneven, but nobody complains.
SPIREDUO-THE_LAST_DUMPLING.pages.SHARE_T: The dumpling is gone before either of you can change your mind.
SPIREDUO-THE_LAST_DUMPLING.pages.LEAVE_I: You walk away together. The dumpling can wait.
SPIREDUO-BORROWED_HAMMOCK.title: Borrowed Hammock
A hammock hangs between two pillars. It looks sturdy enough for one. Probably.
Decide how to spend the break.
SPIREDUO-BORROWED_HAMMOCK.pages.SCHEDULE: The hammock creaks while you negotiate the schedule.
Gain [green]{MaxHp}[/green] Max HP. Upgrade a card.
SPIREDUO-BORROWED_HAMMOCK.pages.KOALA_FI: The nap is brief, but perfectly timed.
SPIREDUO-BORROWED_HAMMOCK.pages.PANDA_FI: The hammock survives. So does your pack.
SPIREDUO-BORROWED_HAMMOCK.pages.BOTH_CLI: It sways, groans, and somehow holds.
SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_TOLLBOOTH.title: Eucalyptus Tollbooth
SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_TOLLBOOTH.pages.INIT: A sleepy queue winds past a tiny tollbooth. The attendant offers you a cushion.
SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_TOLLBOOTH.pages.NAP_: The line moves slowly. Your card learns to rest with you.
The gate lifts without a sound.
SPIREDUO-EUCALYPTUS_TOLLBOOTH.pages.TURN: The longer way looks peaceful enough.
SPIREDUO-HONEYED_HIVE.title: Honeyed Hive
SPIREDUO-HONEYED_HIVE.pages.INITIAL.desc: A hive drips with honey beside the path. It hums with warning.
SPIREDUO-HONEYED_HIVE.pages.BACK_AWAY.de: You leave the honey for the bees and keep walking.
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_APPRAISER.title: Bamboo Appraiser
An appraiser taps a bamboo ruler against your pack and smiles knowingly.
Trade a tradable Relic for a random Relic.
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_APPRAISER.pages.TRADE_A_: The swap is quick and pleasantly mysterious.
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_APPRAISER.pages.APPRAISE: He points out a clean cut in the grain.
Enchant a Panda card that Munches with [gold]Freshly-Cut[/gold].
Choose a Panda card that Munches.
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_APPRAISER.pages.FRESH_CU: The card smells faintly of cut bamboo.
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_APPRAISER.pages.LEAVE.de: You thank the appraiser and move on.
SPIREDUO-RAINY_DAY_ARGUMENT.title: Rainy-Day Argument
SPIREDUO-RAINY_DAY_ARGUMENT.pages.INITIA: Rain taps the awning while a small disagreement grows louder.
SPIREDUO-RAINY_DAY_ARGUMENT.pages.AFTER_: After the fight, an apology arrives with a Make Up card.
SPIREDUO-RAINY_DAY_ARGUMENT.pages.MAKE_T: Warm tea makes the next words easier.
SPIREDUO-RAINY_DAY_ARGUMENT.pages.WALK_A: The rain cools your head, eventually.
SPIREDUO-DREAM_EXCHANGE.title: Dream Exchange
SPIREDUO-DREAM_EXCHANGE.pages.INITIAL.de: A quiet clerk opens a ledger full of dreams.
SPIREDUO-DREAM_EXCHANGE.pages.INITIAL.op: Lose {HpLoss}% of current HP. Gain a random Rare card.
SPIREDUO-DREAM_EXCHANGE.pages.DEPOSIT.de: The clerk offers a careful improvement.
SPIREDUO-DREAM_EXCHANGE.pages.UPGRADE_RE: The memory returns brighter than before.
SPIREDUO-DREAM_EXCHANGE.pages.WITHDRAW_O: A rare card waits in your pack.
SPIREDUO-DREAM_EXCHANGE.pages.CLOSE_ACCO: The clerk closes the ledger with a nod.
SPIREDUO-THE_SUMMIT_PICNIC.title: The Summit Picnic
SPIREDUO-THE_SUMMIT_PICNIC.pages.INITIAL: At the summit, a picnic cloth is pinned beneath a warm stone.
SPIREDUO-THE_SUMMIT_PICNIC.pages.MENU.de: There is enough food for a thoughtful choice.
SPIREDUO-THE_SUMMIT_PICNIC.pages.FEAST.d: The view makes every bite feel earned.
SPIREDUO-THE_SUMMIT_PICNIC.pages.PACK_LI: Your pack feels lighter on the way down.
SPIREDUO-THE_SUMMIT_PICNIC.pages.SHARE_R: The last crumbs are the best ones.
